subject: [Acme AI] Interested in Redwood trial & quick walkthrough
body:
From: Priyanka Mehta <priyanka@acmeai.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interested in trial and a quick walkthrough

Hi Neha,

I signed up for the trial this morning and wanted to see if someone could walk me through a quick demo and answer a few questions about data handling and on-prem options. We have a proof-of-concept budget and I want to make sure it maps to your dedicated/private offerings.

A little background: we run ML infra on AWS and would likely try a small production pilot on GPU-backed instances.

Would appreciate a 30-minute slot next week (prefer mornings PT).

Thanks,
Priyanka Mehta
Head of ML Platforms
Acme AI
priyanka@acmeai.com

----

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Priyanka Mehta <priyanka@acmeai.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 16:30:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Interested in trial and a quick walkthrough

Hi Priyanka,

Thanks for signing up and for the context. I pulled together a short 30-minute walkthrough we typically do for platform leads — covers deployment modes, performance profiles, and a quick look at observability and cost controls.

Please pick a time that works for you here: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/30min

If none of those times fit, let me know 2-3 windows next week and I can set something up manually. I cc'd Aditya from the team who can join to talk about infra & dedicated capacity if useful.

I also attached a short 1-pager that outlines our trial onboarding flow and what we typically deliver during a pilot.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
(555) 867-2140

Attachment: quick-demo-guide.pdf (summary, 2 pages, pdf)

----

From: Priyanka Mehta <priyanka@acmeai.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 09:22:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Interested in trial and a quick walkthrough

Hi Neha,

Thanks — I grabbed a Calendly slot for Tue Jul 21 at 9:30 AM PT but realized we have a standing all-hands then. Could we move it to Tue Jul 21 at 11:00 AM PT or Wed Jul 22 at 9:00 AM PT instead? 11:00 on the 21st would be ideal.

Also, is it possible to have a brief mention of SOC 2 and how logs/retention are handled in the trial environment? If Aditya can join that would be great.

Best,
Priyanka

----

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Priyanka Mehta <priyanka@acmeai.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interested in trial and a quick walkthrough

Hi Priyanka,

11:00 AM PT on Tue Jul 21 is confirmed — calendar invite attached. Aditya will join for the infra + SOC 2 discussion and I will run the product walkthrough.

Quick notes for the call:
- We will cover trial provisioning and expected timelines for dedicated capacity.
- SOC 2 scope and where you can find evidence (we have a summary page and can share the auditor report under an NDA).
- We'll show the Console: token-level cost views and rollout controls.

If you have any files or a short architecture diagram you want us to look at ahead of time, please send them over or drop a Drive link.

See you Tuesday — invite attached.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-demo-invite.ics (calendar invite), quick-demo-guide.pdf
Related link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/ACMEAI (HubSpot company record)
